_description: Defines when a playlist should automatically run.

_days._description: Array of weekday identifiers, for example ["sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu"].

_start_time._description: Start time in HH:mm format, for example "08:00".

_end_time._description: End time in HH:mm format, for example "12:00".

_volume._description: Optional volume level. Expected later range: 0-100.
